title: Teh Tarik Pukul Tiga
subject: a mamak stall at three in the morning
caption: Malay R&B, neo-soul leaning. Rhodes electric piano with extended chords, brushed drums, upright bass walking loosely, a muted trumpet in the second verse. A husky female lead sings conversationally with melismatic runs and opens from a near-whisper into a full belt on the last chorus. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, close and late-night. 90 BPM, E-flat major. Intimate, unhurried.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tiga pagi mamak masih buka
Abang tu dah kenal muka aku
Tak payah cakap, dia dah tahu
Teh tarik kurang manis

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tak lapar
Aku cuma tak nak balik

[Chorus]
Duduk sini dulu sekejap
Biar kerusi plastik ni jadi rumah
Tiga ringgit boleh beli
Satu jam yang aku tak perlu fikir

[Verse 2]
Meja sebelah ada budak uni
Bergaduh pasal benda kecil
Aku senyum sikit
Sebab aku pun pernah begitu

[Trumpet Solo]

[Chorus]
Duduk sini dulu sekejap
Biar kerusi plastik ni jadi rumah
Tiga ringgit boleh beli
Satu jam yang aku tak perlu fikir

[Outro]
Satu lagi, abang
Satu lagi
